ASSETS.description: Static site assets for the deliberation planner and results page.

POLIS_SITE_ID.description: Optional: paste the public Site ID generated by your [Pol.is account](https://pol.is/home). This lets your deployed Delib prepare new Pol.is conversations without asking for the ID each time. It is not a password.

POCKET_POLIS_ORIGIN.description: Optional Pocket Polis managed host. The public default is https://polis.mashbean.net; replace it only with a compatible deployment you operate.

CALL_IN_ORIGIN.description: Optional Call-in managed host. The public default is https://call-in.mashbean.net; replace it only with a compatible deployment you operate.
